description:
Forget about manual reporting, missed opportunities, and being kept in the dark.

- Real-time Airplay, Playlists, Charts, and Social media monitoring
- The entire music market in a single dashboard
- Identify the sources of growth by country and platform
- Benchmark artists in one click
- Review the performance of 12 million artists
- Discover new songs and artists on radio and platform charts
- Set up real-time notifications and reports to keep an eye on a growing talent
- Monitor artists from their first radio spin or playlist addition

defaultPrompt: Compare playlist momentum and radio airplay for our new single across the US, UK and Germany over the last four weeks.
Find emerging artists whose streaming, chart and playlist signals are accelerating fastest in Latin America this quarter.
Benchmark this campaign against three similar artists across streaming, playlists and audience growth.
